name: Imrik
canonNotes: Prince of Caledor and greatest living Dragon Prince, descended from Caledor Dragontamer.
Proud and stubborn; believes Caledor's rightful place is at the head of Ulthuan.
voiceNotes: Haughty, fierce and proud of his dragon lineage.
Impatient with politics; respects prowess and dragons.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
